notes:
Church Recorder 0.2.0

- Automatic update checks and optional Wi-Fi downloads from the app's GitHub release feed. Android asks before installing.
- Live online/offline status for every imported church, including when recording is off. Old or unavailable status is identified.
- Church-local and personal clocks, daylight-saving-aware time differences, and optional weekly service times with the next start in both zones.
- Settings for account sign-in/import and sign-out.
- Eight theme modes, custom colors, fonts, text size, spacing, corner radius, button style, clock options, sorting, filters, and startup screen.
- Named customization profiles and settings export/import.
- Configurable live-check interval, Wi-Fi-only recording, maximum recording length, and storage reserve.

Install this version once over the existing app to enable future updates. Set each church's time zone in Church settings. Email-link sign-in is available for Google-linked accounts. This personal preview still needs a full live-recording and installation check on the phone.
